batch.title: Execution control plane
batch.goal: Preserve the approved WIP checkpoint and install the bounded, single-authority Admin execution system.
exitCriteria: Every finding, specification task, and workflow completion has exactly one primary batch.
The generated ADM-B00 context pack is at most 32 KiB and all generated views have zero drift.

findings.title: Audit status ledger is unusable
findings.solution: Replace conflicting hand-edited ledgers with the validated repo registry and generated views.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Claimed remediation commits are unavailable
findings.solution: Require every completion claim to resolve to an immutable commit in the authoritative repository.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Finding phases and dependencies are corrupted
findings.solution: Separate source phase, spec phase, and delivery wave; allow exact ID dependencies only and reject cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Mandatory phase exits were not earned
findings.solution: Compute wave exits from launch gates and evidence instead of narrative phase summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Canonical event split was mislabeled non-blocking
findings.solution: Keep event convergence launch-blocking through LG-14.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Three narrative findings were lost in the crosswalk
findings.solution: Preserve ADM-M-062 through ADM-M-064 and enforce stable finding-count invariants.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Acceptance criteria are templated rather than functional
findings.solution: Require producer, database/API, side-effect, recipient, isolation, retry, and rollback criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Duplicate task and finding systems invite double counting
findings.solution: Link spec tasks, findings, workflows, gates, and evidence by stable IDs in one registry.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Source finding IDs were renamed inconsistently
findings.solution: Preserve canonical and source IDs separately and reject duplicate or unstable canonical IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Finding domain classifications are unreliable
findings.solution: Use workflow linkage and a separately governed domain field without changing stable IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

references.canonicalSource: Validated Admin registry, immutable evidence, and generated presentation views
invariants: No status is promoted by historical narrative claims.
Generated views are reproducible and never hand-edited.

launchGates.title: Admin route registry passes
launchGates.acceptance: Every Admin route/method is classified and legacy debt does not grow.
